figures.alt: Hellotext catalog showing the Cart Saver and AI Cart Saver cards.

figures.caption: Journey Builder is the entry point for designing a custom journey.

figures.alt: Journey list with Active selected and the fictional journey with its Viewed a product trigger.
figures.caption: The fictional journey appears under Active after publishing.

figures.alt: Journey list with Inactive selected and the fictional journey with its Viewed a product trigger.
figures.caption: The same fictional journey appears under Inactive after choosing Make inactive.
